checks.rationale: Pure flat Protocol/dataclass module respects coordinator, adapter and runtime wiring ownership; distinct manual native higher-rank review provenance is documented with its confirmation limits.
ADR-001 through ADR-005 hold: flat typed Python/JSON, qualified state identity, local worktree bindings, exact independent review and injected side effects; no new authority or architectural choice.

Accepted TASK-001/004 and relevant sibling TASK-003 are verified base ancestors with matching passing reviews and unchanged source. The command success rule and common evidence/error values interoperate with accepted validation checks.

All 11 frozen local port signatures and their typed public request/results match. Production imports use standard library and accepted domain_values only; no unaccepted or later adapter imports are needed.

V1 record shapes, shared immutable values and 40/64-character string Git OIDs remain compatible. Missing, conflict and unknown outcomes are explicit; schema-valid command observations do not invent suite success.

Schema projections validate through accepted offline contracts without schema migration. Grouped plan/task/registry/archive effects retain snapshot-relative content hashes and the lifecycle-neutral task digest; portable records exclude host roots.

Frozen typed values, explicit flat imports and plan-local task evidence follow repository conventions. Exact binary diff has only the three owned additions and no schema, registry, shared metadata or central export changes.
Service-specific envelopes reuse shared domain values/errors. No duplicate persistence, subprocess, Git, cleanup or validation implementation is introduced; those remain separate downstream outcomes.

Direct zero-plan events coexist with qualified record lookups; relocation references/manifests share one transaction. Expected versus observed Git identity, unavailable facts, lease generation and non-force cleanup guards retain their distinct meanings.

27 declared tests and five independent scenarios pass. Fresh checks cover cross-contract zero-test rejection, schema-valid initialization/relocation, actual expected/observed Git drift and cleanup/fencing representation; R1's process repair evidence is assessed without repeating its broad matrix.

Handoff accurately records bounded argv repair, preserved failure, interface-only ownership, portable/local separation, 27 leaf versus 24 aggregate discovery and adapter re-observation/security responsibilities; no unimplemented runtime claim.

Both TASK-002 criteria and plan AC-01/02 remain representable for declared consumers. Approved graph/task digests, scope, accepted dependencies, context hashes and same-candidate passing R1 are intact; no structural discovery or replan is required.
